data.review_body:
My first experience with Temu was very disappointing. I spent almost €100 on several items, including scissors, tapes advertised as heavy-duty, and an electric nose hair trimmer. Unfortunately, the products I received were of very poor quality and did not match their descriptions.

When I contacted Temu customer service, I was offered a voucher worth less than €2 as compensation, which I did not consider an adequate resolution.

Based on my experience, I recommend that online shoppers exercise caution when buying from Temu and carefully review product ratings and seller feedback before making a purchase. For me, I have found marketplaces like Amazon to be more reliable.
data.review_headline: My first experience with Temu was disappointing
